Watch: Watch for further details on hyperscaler debt and how tech names react to the upcoming Fed decision and 10-year Treasury yield movements.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk on your leveraged and below-stop positions, especially with mixed signals for tech.
plays: Your SOXL stop at 200 is far above its current 107.6 price. Review this leveraged position's risk and set a realistic stop immediately.
